categories.info:
After discovering a matching pair of Animal Heads, they can be awakened using the [Animal Flute](https://mapgenie.io/animal-well/maps/world?locationIds=356984). You'll know an Animal Head has been "found" when its location is marked by a white pixel on the map.

Use Animal Heads to fast travel around the map.

categories.title: Candle
categories.info:
Candles require a Match to be lit. There are nine total of both. Unlike Matches, Candles cannot be picked up. If you don't have a Match on hand, you'll need to mark the spot on your map and return later.

To check your progress in-game, find the [Candle Tracker](https://mapgenie.io/animal-well/maps/world?locationIds=357356).

locations.title: Pedometer Room
locations.description: Use the [Top](https://mapgenie.io/animal-well/maps/world?locationIds=355614) to break the floor on the far right of the room at the very top of the large shaft. The Pedometer will give various rewards depending on how many steps you have taken in the game. Jump into the Pedometer from the top, and walk left/right once inside. Jump to exit.

locations.title: Animal Head Room
locations.description:
After discovering a matching pair of Animal Heads, they can be awakened using the [Animal Flute](https://mapgenie.io/animal-well/maps/world?locationIds=356984) and unlock a means of fast travel.

The Animal Head Room contains a cluster of six Animal Heads, allowing you to chain multiple fast travel points together in quick succession.

locations.title: Jellyfish Room
locations.description:
With the UV Lantern, play the notes depicted by the Jellyfish in the Skeleton Fish to be transported here. 

Land on the ground to open a secret door into the [Animal Head Room](https://mapgenie.io/animal-well/maps/world?locationIds=379623).

locations.title: 65th Egg Incubator
locations.description: Used to incubate the 65th egg for the final, final boss.

locations.title: Manticore 2
locations.description: Second Manticore for the Good Ending.

locations.title: Manticore Song
locations.description: Play the Animal Flute here, then enter the Manticore's mouth for the second ending.

locations.title: Super Special Ability
locations.description:
Once you reach Rabbit Island and have found all 16 (currently) Rabbits, go to the far right of the island by the flag. Get in a Manticore's mouth, and move through the screens in the following order:

↑←↑←↑→↑↑←↓←↑↑↑→→↓→↑↑↑←↓←↑←↑→→→↑←

You will arrive at a new location. Follow the path, and get eaten by the creature there. Go through and err... Out the other end. Once you do, press the jump button twice to use your new ability!

locations.title: The Final Secret
locations.description:
From the room to the left of the giant Rabbit, use your new special ability to travel in the following directions:

←←↑←↓←↑←↓↓→↓→↑→↓↓→↑→↓↓→↓←←↓←↑↑←←

You will reach a tiny island. Use the top to dig up the ground, and you will find something to interact with. Once you do, make sure you have volume on for a well earned secret message, and congratulations on reaching the final secret.

locations.title: Zen Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
1. After entering the room, move all the way left to lure the chinchilla left, positioning it under the chest
2. Push the lower button, releasing the chest onto the head of the chinchilla
3. Lure the chinchilla right, until it is on the lower trapdoor
4. Push the upper button, to release the lower trapdoor
5. Lure the chinchilla right, so that it drops the chest on the upper button.
6. Keep luring the chinchilla right so that it drops down ONCE
7. Immediately switch to lure the chinchilla left, so that it can go stand on the lower button.

locations.title: Secret Rabbit
locations.description:
This rabbit is easilly obtained. Just leave your character still until they fall asleep. After a while, a sleep rabbit will appear in a bubble over their head. When it appears, jump up to it and touch it, and it will become real. Touch it as normal to collect it.
Character falls asleep after 20 seconds.
Rabbit will appear after sleeping for 2 minutes and 40 seconds.
Stay still for 3 minutes total.

locations.title: Office Key
locations.description:
After getting all 64 eggs, you must playe a long series of notes in the Egg Room to unlock this room. The sequence is below:

↖↓→↓↖↓→↓↖↙  
↘↙↖↙↘↙↗←↓←  
↗←↓←↗←↓←↑←  
↘←↑←↘←↖↓→↓  
↖↓→↓↖↙↘↙↖↙  
↘↙↖↗↖↙↗↑←↓  
↑↖↙←↑↖←↖

Unlocks the [Office Door](https://mapgenie.io/animal-well/maps/world?locationIds=357061).

locations.title: Hidden Path
locations.description:
Reach the far left of the water room by riding on the Disc.
Now use the Bubble Wand to get as high as you can.
Use the Disc on the left wall, then ride it across to this point.
There is a secret door hidden in the ivy. Jump through it to enter.
